pages.text: Most crops grow wild: look for small patches in fitting biomes, and break them for seeds (a seed's tooltip says where its plant grows). Breaking grass sometimes gives $(item)barley$() and $(item)oat$() seeds, and $(item)rye$() in cold biomes, so beer is possible on day one.

Village houses keep their region's seeds in their chests. Desert pyramids hide $(item)agave pups$(), jungle temples $(item)vanilla$() and $(item)coffee$(). The wandering trader sells the exotic crops too.
